about_the_game:
🌲 About This Game

Lodge Simulator is a cozy indie simulation game where you build, manage, and expand your very own lodge in the wilderness. Start small with a wooden cabin, attract guests, and turn your retreat into the ultimate getaway.

🏡 Build and Upgrade

Design your lodge from the ground up. Add rooms, furniture, and outdoor facilities to make your property unique. Upgrade over time to transform a simple hut into a thriving destination.

👥 Guest Management

Welcome travelers with different needs and personalities. Fulfill their requests, keep them satisfied, and earn positive reviews. A good reputation brings more guests and greater profits.

💰 Strategy and Economy

Every choice matters. Balance your budget, invest in new features, and decide how to grow your lodge. Will you focus on comfort, luxury, or adventure?

🌦️ Immersive World

Experience a dynamic day-night cycle, changing weather, and a detailed natural environment. Watch your lodge come alive as the world evolves around it.

🎨 Customization

Personalize interiors and surroundings to match your vision. Create a rustic hideaway, a modern retreat, or a luxurious resort — the choice is yours.
